This page contains two tables of metrics. Both tables contain metrics from all GKE Enterprise versions, so it's possible that some of the metrics listed don't apply your clusters.

The first table lets you filter by one or more components or by a text string you type in. The text string search isn't case sensitive. However, when you filter by a text string, the text used to filter must be an exact match of a string in the table. The text string you type doesn't need to be a complete match of a metric name. Note that the first table doesn't cover all metric component areas, yet.

If you're looking for a metric and can't find it in the first table, check the second table, which is in the Full metric definitions section. The second table is comprehensive, but it also includes many deprecated metrics, which may not work with your clusters.
